verdict.rationale: Alloy is a SaaS identity, fraud and KYC platform that stores customer PII, so choosing a data region is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection, data residency options, or regional hosting. The only storage-related item says Sandbox and Production share a single data store for the account, which concerns mode isolation rather than geographic residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
